figures.caption: Table 1: Comparison on MLLMU, CLEAR, and UMU benchmarks. ↓ Lower is better for Forget VQA accuracy (forgetting of target visual knowledge), ↑ Higher is better for the others (retention of non-target visual knowledge and textual knowledge). For MLLMU and UMU, the Forget/Retain QA tasks are evaluated using the Accuracy, while for CLEAR, these tasks are evaluated using the ROUGE-L metric.

Figure 2: Evaluation of continual unlearning with five sequential forgetting tasks. (a) Average VQA accuracy over cumulative Forget sets across tasks. (b) VQA accuracy on the Retain set across tasks. (c) VQA accuracy on the Real-world set across tasks.
Figure 5: Qualitative results of GA, MANU, MMUNLEARNER, and our method on Forget/Retain VQA and Forget/Retain QA tasks.
